psychological_meaning: Stonewall represents stability, resilience, and groundedness. It evokes a sense of calm and dependability, suggesting steadfastness and a connection to the earth. It can also communicate neutrality and a lack of strong emotion, offering a sense of refuge from overwhelming stimuli.
